out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed boxes of sugar stored on floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM will move all foods to shelves or purchase additional dunnage racks to keep food off floor.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. Observed no employees wearing hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS informed CFM that all employees must wear hair restrains - hair nets, hats, visors - when preparing drinks, boba.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths stored on counter tops of preparation area.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS educated CFM on proper storage of wet wiping cloths in bleach sanitizer solution that must be changed every 4 hours or whenever visibly soiled.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed spoons used for cooking/transferring boba stored in water that was 84F and 124F.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS educated CFM that if keeping in-use utensils in hot water, water must be maintained at a temperature of 135F or higher. CFM stated their procedure is to change out utensil hot water constantly and refill from hot water tap. EHS recommended placing thermometer in in-use utensil hot water container to verify and monitor temperature of water at all times.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: floor joint where floor meets tea counter, interior face of glass shield at counter and sneeze guard.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. CFM will have contractor address requirement to provide watertight seal at both areas mentioned.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. Observed employee belongings stored on shelves above single-service items in back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. Designate bottom shelves for storage of all employee belongings. Ensure items are not stored above any food, equipment, utensils, or single-service items.
